svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Posts: cut four lengths of 582 mm, square, and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Water post: cut one length of 200 mm from the same bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tap the centre hole M5, 12 deep, at both ends of every piece

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the water post needs the bottom end only).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each post stands on the frame through a notch in the deck,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by inside corner brackets: a front post by two (front and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back), a rear post by one on its inner side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The water post is screwed to the deck from below, into its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tapped end, before the deck goes on the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before standing a post up, slide in T-nuts: four in the front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slot of each rear post for the panel screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every post upright within 1 mm over its length.
